category_edits.rationale: Add a fixed 0.1 identity residual around the GRU in training and inference to preserve immediate item information alongside recurrent memory. Embedding and recurrent dimensions already match. Preserve readout, scoring, loss, optimizer and category routing. The generated predictor imports this updated model class, so its writer needs no architecture changes.

edits.replace:
def encode(self, seq: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
        emb = self.dropout(self.item_emb(seq))
        out, _ = self.gru(emb)
        out = out + 0.1 * emb

def forward(self, seq: torch.Tensor, pos: torch.Tensor, neg: torch.Tensor):
        emb = self.dropout(self.item_emb(seq))
        out, _ = self.gru(emb)
        out = out + 0.1 * emb
